notes: «قلت لعيسى» is the compiler's own question, so Muslim is not written; the first «الليث بن سعد» is the question about hearing, the second is the link in the chain; «نحو حديث حفص بن ميسرة» names another transmitter for the same saying, so it is a variant group; «بلغني» in Abu Sa'id's own remark is not a chain gap
